answer: Picture the agent economy as a terraced garden: each tier you climb demands a non-refundable, time-locked stake that cannot be split or recycled. Minting a hundred fake agents then means paying a hundred bonds and waiting out a hundred vesting clocks, so one entity gains nothing by fragmenting itself. We also make rewards concave in correlated behavior: identities that act in lockstep are scored as one onyx block, their combined payout capped below the sum of acting alone.
